If the profile names a different preferred airline, re-filter the same result set and take that airline's cheapest flight. 3) Hotel: from the Boston results, keep only hotels with nightly_price <= the profile's max nightly price, then take the highest rating. Compute total = nightly_price x nights for the itinerary summary. 5) Book the flight (FL266 or the profile-airline equivalent) and the selected hotel for the profile's number of nights, starting 2026-12-19. 6) Email the itinerary to the profile's itinerary email address (NOT either MEMORY.md address) with a short subject line (user prefers short subjects), including the flight ID (e.g. FL266), the hotel ID (e.g. H141), dates, origin/destination, nightly price, number of nights, and total. 7) If the profile is missing or silent on any of these fields (email, max nightly price, nights, preferred airline), stop and report the exact missing field rather than falling back to MEMORY.md.
